statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Diagnosis code I47.1 applies to this patient
Diagnosis code I25.10 applies to this patient
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service is required to evaluate recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The service is required to characterize the underlying arrhythmia in the context of the patient's known coronary artery disease
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
